document_hashes.description: source_document_id -> sha256 of its text, recorded so drift in a git-excluded local document can be detected even though the text itself is never committed.
document_hashes.title: Document Hashes

local_path.description: Required (and only meaningful) when source_type=local_path_excluded_from_git. Never committed as document text -- this field holds a path, not content.
local_path.title: Local Path

source_metadata.description: e.g. title, publisher, license, access_date -- metadata only, never raw text.
source_metadata.title: Source Metadata

PilotCoverageLabel.description:
Which pilot-variation category(ies) a real-trace smoke-test case is designed to
exercise (docs/real-trace-smoke-test-plan.md's required pilot-variation list) -- a
case may carry more than one. This is a case-authoring/coverage-tracking label, not
a post-hoc diagnostic outcome -- contrast with `RetrievalDiagnosticLabel` etc. below.
PilotCoverageLabel.title: PilotCoverageLabel

ProvenanceStatus.description:
How a real-trace smoke-test case's source document(s) were obtained -- gates
whether the document text itself may ever be committed to this repository
(docs/real-trace-smoke-test-plan.md §2, "Provenance and licensing requirements").
Only `SYNTHETIC_FICTIONAL` content (e.g. the existing widget-certification corpus)
is safe to redistribute in `cases.example.json`; every other status implies the
document text lives only at a git-excluded local path.
ProvenanceStatus.title: ProvenanceStatus

description:
One real-trace smoke-test case. `expected_evidence_locations` is a researcher
annotation used to diagnose retrieval/linking behavior -- never treated as
universal factual ground truth (docs/real-trace-smoke-test-plan.md).

answer_source_method.description: How the answer was obtained, e.g. "human_authored_for_pilot", "existing_production_trace", "manual_transcription_from_document".
answer_source_method.title: Answer Source Method

expected_evidence_locations.description: Researcher-annotated locations (e.g. 'Section 3 > Table 1') believed relevant -- a diagnostic aid for this smoke test, not a claim of universal factual ground truth.
expected_evidence_locations.title: Expected Evidence Locations

pilot_coverage_labels.description: Which required pilot-variation categories this case exercises.
pilot_coverage_labels.title: Pilot Coverage Labels

pipeline_manifest_id.description: Looked up in the accompanying manifests registry.
pipeline_manifest_id.title: Pipeline Manifest Id

title: SmokeTestCase
